description: This is an Android Java class 'ReceiptsAdd' implementing a Fragment for adding receipts, including capturing or selecting an image, filling in details, and uploading the receipt image along with its metadata to a server.

classes.name: ReceiptsAdd
classes.description: A Fragment class enabling users to add receipts including image capture, input of amount and reason, and uploading data to a server.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the ReceiptsAdd fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI components, and sets click listeners for capturing and uploading receipts.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Initiates camera intent to capture an image and save it to a temporary file.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the camera activity, loads the captured image into the ImageView.

methods.name: uploadBitmap
methods.description: Uploads the bitmap image to a server using a custom Volley request.

methods.name: getFileDataFromDrawable
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap into a byte array for uploading.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as DDMMYY.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Sends receipt data including amount, reason, and image URL to update server database.

methods.name: grabImage
methods.description: Loads an image from URI, resizes it, and sets it into an ImageView.

methods.name: createTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in external storage for storing captured images.
